title: Saved engineering interfaces release their views on reload
summary: Actual common host cleanup on two saved model-created interfaces; no process restart or review response.

manualSteps.label: Open interface
manualSteps.instruction: Open the saved Heat comparison or Focus-wheel working-interface link.

manualSteps.label: Reload
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the page three times. Check that the same saved interface and exact results return.

manualSteps.label: Leave workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Navigate away. Return to the saved interface and check its results. Leave all review decisions unchanged.

steps.summary: Sandbox policy prevented Chromium from starting.
steps.actual: Chromium spawn EPERM; no browser, navigation or screenshot exists.
